title: Can LLMs Synthesize Court-Ready Statistical Evidence? Evaluating AI-Assisted Sentencing Bias Analysis for California Racial Justice Act Claims

bias_targets.methodology: The paper presents a platform that calculates statistical metrics (Odds Ratio, Relative Risk, Chi-Square Test) to measure racial disparities in sentencing and charging using California prison records. Additionally, the paper evaluates the interpretative layer (powered by an LLM) to ensure it does not perpetuate racial harms, specifically measuring 'Appropriate Attribution' to verify that the model ascribes observed disparities to systemic factors rather than inherent criminal behavior.
